verdict.rationale: Docs describe a built-in AI assistant/agent (accessible in-app and via Slack) that can draft emails, build segments from plain text, analyze the workspace, and run scheduled recurring tasks like deliverability reports — clear delegation of tasks beyond just API/MCP tooling for external agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming the assistant's real-world reliability and scope limits beyond first-party docs.
